name: Oxytocin
description: Nine-amino-acid peptide hormone from the pituitary gland; the medicine form is synthetic

status.humanEvidence: FDA approved (labor); small studies in men

note.lead: All studies in men used a nasal spray.
note.text: No human study of oxytocin by mouth, strip, troche or gummy was found. Use for male sexual function is off-label.

bullets: **Binds its receptors** in the womb and raises calcium in muscle cells
**Holds water** in the kidneys; its structure is close to vasopressin
**In male rats,** brain oxytocin increased mating (animal research)
**In men,** an effect on sexual function is not established
FDA approved only for labor and after birth
5 small studies in men, mostly one dose
No Phase II or III trial in men

notEstablished.text: Effect on sexual function in men

practical.routes: Vein or muscle injection (label); nasal spray in men’s studies
practical.pharmacokinetics: Removed from blood mainly by the kidney and liver
practical.soldAs: Rx injection (Pitocin, generics); compounded forms unapproved
practical.monitored: Contractions, water balance, blood pressure (label, in labor)

regulatory.text: Approved injection for labor (Pitocin); not for men

references: Behnia et al., Horm Behav, oxytocin in couples, Mar 2014
Burri et al., Psychoneuroendocrinology, oxytocin and sexual arousal, Jun 2008
